public subroutine uf_rtxlogout ();//====================================================================
// 函数: n_rtxsdk.uf_rtxlogout()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:注销当前用户
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	syc		日期: 2010年07月20日
//====================================================================

long ll_rtn
string ls_dept,ls_Account
oleobject ole_RTXAPI
oleobject ole_KernalRoot
oleobject ole_App
oleobject ole_Helper

ole_RTXAPI=create oleobject
ll_rtn=ole_RTXAPI.ConnectToNewObject("RTXClient.RTXAPI")//("RTXCAPI.RTXCRoot")//("RTXClient.RTXAPI")
if ll_rtn<>0 then
	of_connecterrormsg(ll_rtn,"RTXClient.RTXAPI")
	destroy ole_RTXAPI
	return
end if
TRY
	
 	ole_App=create oleobject
	ole_App = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("AppRoot")
	
	ole_Helper=create oleobject
	ole_Helper = ole_App.GetAppObject("RTXHelper")
	
	ole_KernalRoot=create oleobject
	ole_KernalRoot = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("KernalRoot")
	ls_Account=ole_KernalRoot.Account
	
	ls_dept = ole_Helper.GetBuddyDept(ls_Account)
	
	if pos(ls_dept,'信息技术科')=0 then	
		ole_KernalRoot.Logout()
	end if
	
CATCH (throwable rtxloge)
FINALLY 
END TRY

if isvalid(ole_App) then destroy ole_App
if isvalid(ole_Helper) then destroy ole_Helper
if isvalid(ole_KernalRoot) then destroy ole_KernalRoot
ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
destroy ole_RTXAPI
	

end subroutine

blocks.name: uf_rtxlogin
blocks.text:
public subroutine uf_rtxlogin (string as_rtxserverip, string as_webport, long al_rtxport, string as_rtxuser);//====================================================================
// 函数: n_rtxsdk.uf_rtxlogin()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:单点登录，再其它系统登录成功后调用该篋AT*
�数，可以自动登录rtx。该函数会自动安装rtx（不支持win98），自动运行rtx。
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	string	as_rtxserverip	 服务器地址
// 	string	as_webport    	web服务端口(默认'8012')
// 	long  	al_rtxport   登录端口(默认8000) 	
// 	string	as_rtxuser    	账号

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	syc		菵AT*
: 2010年07月20日
//====================================================================
if not isnumber(as_rtxuser) then return
ulong ll_hwnd
long ll_i,ll_recount
long ll_rtn

string ls_Session,ls_url
string ls_curpath
string ls_rtxpath,ls_rtxtitle
string ls_Account
string ls_ver
string ls_errmsg
string ls_svradder

n_getmemorystatus_api ln_getmemorystatus_api
ulong	ll_MemoryLoad  // 	已装入内存
ulong	ll_TotalPhys   // 	总物理内存
ulong	ll_AvailPhys   // 	可用物理内存
ulong	ll_TotalPageFile//	分页大小
ulong	ll_AvailPageFile//	可用分页大小
ulong	ll_TotalVirtual //	虚拟内存大小
ulong	ll_AvailVirtual //	可用虚拟内存大小
	
n_netapi_rtx ln_netapi_rtx
string ls_serverip

string ls_appname
ls_appname=getapplication().appname

INet linet
n_netresult_rtx lir_data


Environment le_Env
if FileExists( "c:\Program Files\Venturcom\BXP\BNClient.exe") then 
	return
end if

ln_getmemorystatus_api.uf_globalmemorystatus( ll_memoryload,ll_totalphys,ll_availphys,ll_totalpagefile,ll_availpagefile,ll_totalvirtual,ll_availvirtual)
if ll_TotalPhys <=1024 then//内存小于400M不允许
	return
end if
if RegistryGet( "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\CLSID\{5EEEA87D-160E-4A2D-8427-B6C333FEDA4D}\InprocServer32", "", RegString!, ls_rtxpath )=-1 then
	//rtx未安装
	
	GetEnvironment(le_Env)
	if le_Env.OSMajorRevision<5 then//98 NT
	else
		//run("\\fey02\wyhis\wyhis\RTX\rtxcsetup.exe /S")
	end if
	
	return
else
	ls_rtxpath=left(ls_rtxpath,lastpos(ls_rtxpath,'\'))
end if

//'C:\Program Files\Tencent\RTXC\Accounts\rtx.cfg'
//[Default]nAutoLogin=0 basicconfig_page_bCloseToMin=0 nSavePwd=0
if ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nAutoLogin','1')='1' then
	setProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nAutoLogin','0')
end if
if ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','basicconfig_page_bCloseToMin','1')='1' then
	setProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','basicconfig_page_bCloseToMin','0')
end if
if ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nSavePwd','1')='1' then
	setProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nSavePwd','0')
end if

ls_svradder=uf_encodertx( as_rtxserverip)

if ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','strSvrAddr','')<>ls_svradder then
	setProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','strSvrAddr',ls_svradder)
end if
if ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nSvrPort','')<>string(al_rtxport) then
	setProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','nSvrPort',string(al_rtxport))
end if

ls_rtxtitle=ProfileString(ls_rtxpath + 'Accounts\rtx.cfg','Default','Server_page_etrunk_name','RTX 2009')

oleobject ole_RTXAPI
oleobject ole_KernalRoot
oleobject ole_Ver,ole_AppRoot

ole_RTXAPI=create oleobject
ll_rtn=ole_RTXAPI.ConnectToNewObject("RTXClient.RTXAPI")
if ll_rtn<>0 then
	of_connecterrormsg(ll_rtn,"RTXClient.RTXAPI")
	destroy ole_RTXAPI
	return
end if
TRY
	
	ll_hwnd=FindWindow(0,ls_rtxtitle)
	if ll_hwnd<=0 then
		
				
		if le_Env.OSMajorRevision<5 then//98 NT
			ls_curpath=GetCurrentDirectory()
			ChangeDirectory(ls_rtxpath)
			run(ls_rtxpath  + "RTX.exe")
			if ls_appname='rtxlogin' then
				ll_recount=15
				for ll_i=1 to ll_recount
					uf_delay(1)
					yield()
					ll_hwnd=FindWindow(0,ls_rtxtitle)
					if ll_hwnd>0 then exit
					
				next
			end if
			ChangeDirectory(ls_curpath)
		else
			run('start /D "' + ls_rtxpath + '" "' + ls_rtxpath  + '"RTX.exe')
			if ls_appname='rtxlogin' then
				ll_recount=15
				for ll_i=1 to ll_recount
					uf_delay(1)
					yield()
					ll_hwnd=FindWindow(0,ls_rtxtitle)
					if ll_hwnd>0 then exit
					
				next
			end if
		end if
		
		ole_AppRoot=create oleobject
		ole_AppRoot = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("AppRoot")
	
		ole_Ver=create oleobject
		ole_Ver = ole_AppRoot.GetAppObject("Version")//在AppRoot中获取Version对象
		
		ls_ver = ole_Ver.GetCompileVer
		if isvalid(ole_Ver) then destroy ole_Ver
		if isvalid(ole_AppRoot) then destroy ole_AppRoot
		
		if ls_ver<'8.0.546.202' then//自动升级
		
			if not FileExists( "c:\Program Files\Venturcom\BXP\BNClient.exe") then 
				if ll_hwnd>0 then post(ll_hwnd, 16, 0, 0)
				//run("\\fey02\wyhis\wyhis\RTX\rtxcsetup.exe /S")
				return
			end if
			
		end if
		
			
			
	end if
	

	
	ole_KernalRoot=create oleobject
	ole_KernalRoot = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("KernalRoot")
	
	if isnull(ole_KernalRoot) then
		ole_KernalRoot.disconnectobject()
		destroy ole_KernalRoot
		
		ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
		destroy ole_RTXAPI
		//this.uf_sendmsg( as_rtxserverip, as_webport, '信息技术科', "登录腾讯通出错" + getapplication().appname,"KernalRoot isnull")
		this.uf_log("登录腾讯通出错" + getapplication().appname + " KernalRoot isnull")
		return
	
	end if
	
	try
		ls_Account=ole_KernalRoot.Account
	CATCH (throwable Accounte)
		
		//this.uf_sendmsg( as_rtxserverip, as_webport, '信息技术緿AT*
', "登录腾讯通出错出错" + getapplication().appname,'ole_KernalRoot.Account error:' + Accounte.text) 		this.uf_log( "登录腾讯通出错出错" + getapplication().appname + ' ole_KernalRoot.Account error:' + Accounte.text) 		 	FINALLY  	END TRY

	if ls_Account=as_rtxuser then
		if ole_KernalRoot.MyPresence<>0 then//0 离线 2 离开 1 在线
			ole_KernalRoot.disconnectobject()
			destroy ole_KernalRoot
			
			ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
			destroy ole_RTXAPI
		
			return
		end if
	elseif ls_Account<>'' then
		ole_KernalRoot.Logout()
	end if
		
	if ole_KernalRoot.MyPresence=0 then
		ls_url="http://" +as_rtxserverip + ":"+as_webport+"/GetSession.cgi?receiver=" + as_rtxuser
		linet=create inet
		lir_data = CREATE n_netresult_rtx
		linet.GetURL(ls_url, lir_data)
		ls_Session=lir_data.uf_gethtml()
		if pos(ls_Session,'用户不存在')=0 then
		
			if pos(ls_Session,'<html')>0 or pos(ls_Session,'Fatal error')>0 then
				linet.GetURL(ls_url, lir_data)
				ls_Session=lir_data.uf_gethtml()
				if pos(ls_Session,'<html')>0 or pos(ls_Session,'Fatal error')>0 then
					//this.uf_sendmsg( as_rtxserverip, as_webport, '信息技术科', "取Session出错" + getapplication().appname,"返回结果：" + ls_Session)
					this.uf_log(  "取Session出错" + getapplication().appname + " 返回结果：" + ls_Session)
				end if
		
			end if
		else
			if pos(ls_Session,'用户不存在')>0 then this.uf_sendmsg( as_rtxserverip, as_webport, '信息技术科', "取Session出错" + getapplication().appname,"返回结笵AT* " + as_rtxuser + " " + ls_Session)
			this.uf_log("取Session出错" + getapplication().appname + " 返回结果：" + ls_Session)
		end if
		destroy lir_data
		destroy linet 
		
		ls_serverip=as_rtxserverip
		if len(ls_serverip)<=15 then
			ll_i=pos(ls_serverip,'.')
			do while ll_i>0
				ls_serverip=replace(ls_serverip,ll_i,1,'')
				ll_i=pos(ls_serverip,'.',ll_i)
			loop
		end if
		if not isnumber(ls_serverip) then
			
			ls_serverip=ln_netapi_rtx.uf_getip(ls_serverip)
			if ls_serverip<>'0.0.0.0' and ls_serverip<>'' then
				as_rtxserverip=ls_serverip
			end if
		end if
		if not (pos(ls_Session,'<html')>0 or pos(ls_Session,'Fatal error')>0) then
			ole_KernalRoot.LoginSessionKey(as_rtxserverip,al_rtxport,as_rtxuser,ls_Session)
		end if
//		ls_Account=ole_KernalRoot.Account
//		if ls_Account<>'' then
//			if ole_KernalRoot.MyPresence=0 then
//				this.uf_log( "账号：" + as_rtxuser + " 服务器：" + as_rtxserverip + " 端口：" + string(al_rtxport) + " 登陆失败！")
//			end if
//		end if 
	end if
	
	
CATCH (throwable rtxloge)
	ll_hwnd=FindWindow(0,ls_rtxtitle)
	if ll_hwnd=0 then
		
	else
		
		ls_errmsg=rtxloge.text + " FindRTXWindow=" + string(ll_hwnd) + " Session=" + ls_Session
		//this.uf_sendmsg( as_rtxserverip, as_webport, '信息技术科', "登录腾讯通出错" + getapplication().appname,ls_errmsg)
		this.uf_log( "登录腾讯通出错" + getapplication().appname + " " + ls_errmsg)
	end if
FINALLY 
END TRY

if isvalid(ole_KernalRoot) then destroy ole_KernalRoot
ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
destroy ole_RTXAPI

//if ls_errmsg<>'' then 
//	//messagebox("登录腾讯通出错:",ls_errmsg)
//	if not FileExists( "c:\Program Files\Venturcom\BXP\BNClient.exe") then 
//		if pos(lower(ls_errmsg),'name not found calling external object function loginsessionkey')>0 then
//			//run("\\fey02\wyhis\wyhis\RTX\rtxcsetup.exe /S")
//		end if
//	end if
//end if
end subroutine

blocks.name: uf_delay
blocks.text:
public subroutine uf_delay (long al_delay);long ll_delay, ll_cpu

ll_delay = al_delay * 1000
ll_cpu = cpu()
do until cpu() - ll_cpu > ll_delay
	yield()
loop

return
end subroutine

blocks.text:
public function string uf_encodertx (string as_str);int li_asc
long ll_i,ll_len,ll_addasc=0
char lc_char
string ls_encode
ll_len=len(as_str)

for ll_i=1 to ll_len
	lc_char=mid(as_str,ll_i,1)
	li_asc=asc(lc_char)
	ll_addasc=ll_addasc+li_asc
	
	ls_encode=ls_encode + uf_dectohex(int(li_asc/16)) + uf_dectohex(mod(li_asc,16)) + "00"
	
next
li_asc=mod(ll_addasc,128)
ls_encode=ls_encode + fill('0',1024 - len(ls_encode)) + uf_dectohex(int(li_asc/16)) + uf_dectohex(mod(li_asc,16))

return ls_encode
end function

blocks.text:
protected function boolean of_getbit (long al_decimal, unsignedinteger ai_bit);Boolean lb_null

If IsNull(al_decimal) or IsNull(ai_bit) then
    SetNull(lb_null)
    Return lb_null
End If

If Int(Mod(al_decimal / (2 ^(ai_bit - 1)), 2)) > 0 Then
    Return True
End If

Return False
end function

blocks.name: of_bitwiseand
blocks.text:
protected function long of_bitwiseand (long al_value1, long al_value2);Integer   li_Cnt
Long    ll_Result
Boolean   lb_Value1[32], lb_Value2[32]


If IsNull(al_Value1) Or IsNull(al_Value2) Then
	SetNull(ll_Result)
	Return ll_Result
End If

For li_Cnt = 1 To 32
	lb_Value1[li_Cnt] = of_getbit(al_Value1, li_Cnt)
	lb_Value2[li_Cnt] = of_getbit(al_Value2, li_Cnt)
Next

For li_Cnt = 1 To 32
	If lb_Value1[li_Cnt] And lb_Value2[li_Cnt] Then
		ll_Result = ll_Result + (2^(li_Cnt - 1))
	End If
Next

Return ll_Result

end function

blocks.name: uf_sendim
blocks.text:
public subroutine uf_sendim (string as_receiver, string as_msg);//====================================================================
// 函数: n_rtxsdk.uf_sendim()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:弹出IM窗口,直接发送消息，需要登录腾讯通
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	string	as_receiver	接收人，以逗号隔开
// 	string	as_msg     	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	syc		日期: 2010年11月11日
//====================================================================

long ll_rtn
oleobject ole_RTXAPI
oleobject ole_AppRoot
oleobject ole_IM

ole_RTXAPI=create oleobject
ll_rtn=ole_RTXAPI.ConnectToNewObject("RTXClient.RTXAPI")//("RTXCAPI.RTXCRoot")//("RTXClient.RTXAPI")
if ll_rtn<>0 then
	of_connecterrormsg(ll_rtn,"RTXClient.RTXAPI")
	destroy ole_RTXAPI
	return
end if
TRY
	ole_AppRoot=create oleobject
	ole_AppRoot = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("AppRoot")

	ole_IM=create oleobject
	ole_IM = ole_AppRoot.GetAppObject("RTXPlugin.IM")
	/*
	弹出IM窗口。

HRESULT SendIM([in] VARIANT Receiver, [in] VARIANT Parameter,[in] VARIANT Extra, [out, retval] VARIANT* Result); 


Parameters 
　 Receiver [in] 即时消息的接受者，如果是多人，中间采用“；”隔开，如要同时跟benchen和Mike发送短信，接受者应该为“benchen；Mike” 

Return Values 
　IM窗口 hwnd

	*/
	uLong ll_IMHwnd,ll_setpos
	
	//RichEdit20W
	uLong ll_edit
	String ls_edittitle
//	long VK_Return=13
//	long VK_CONTROL = 17
//	long WM_KEYDOWN = 256
//	long WM_KEYUP = 257
	long EM_REPLACESEL = 194

	long ll_ScreenW,ll_ScreenH
	long HWND_TOPMOST = -1,HWND_TOP = 0,SWP_NOSIZE = 1,SWP_NOMOVE =2
	str_rect_win lpRect
	
	
	Environment	le_Env
	GetEnvironment(le_Env)
	ll_ScreenW = le_Env.ScreenWidth 
	ll_ScreenH = le_Env.ScreenHeight

	ll_IMHwnd=ole_IM.SendIM(as_Receiver,"","")
//	messagebox("",string(ll_IMHwnd))
	if ll_IMHwnd>0 then
		//RTX 获取 输入信息框 句柄
		
		//#32770' ---  AfxWnd42 -- RichEdit20A
		ls_edittitle = 'RichEdit20W'
		
		ll_edit=FindWindowEx(ll_IMHwnd, 0,ls_edittitle,0 ) //FindWindowExA(ll_IMHwnd, ll_null,ls_null,ls_text ) 
		if ll_edit>0 then
			if send(ll_edit,EM_REPLACESEL,1,as_msg)>0 then
				ll_setpos=SetWindowPos(ll_IMHwnd,HWND_TOPMOST,0,0,1,1,SWP_NOSIZE + SWP_NOMOVE)
				if ll_setpos>0 then
					GetWindowRect(ll_IMHwnd,ref lpRect)
					mouse_event(32775,(lprect.b_right -163) * 65535/ le_Env.ScreenWidth ,(lpRect.b_bottom -24) * 65535/ le_Env.ScreenHeight  ,0,GetMessageExtraInfo())
				end if
			//MOUSEEVENTF_ABSOLUTE +   MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN +  MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP=32775
				SetWindowPos(ll_IMHwnd,HWND_TOP,0,0,1,1,SWP_NOSIZE + SWP_NOMOVE)
				
			end if
		end if
	end if
	 
CATCH (throwable SendIMe)
	messagebox("腾讯通SendIM出错:"+ getapplication().appname,SendIMe.text)
FINALLY 
END TRY

if isvalid(ole_AppRoot) then destroy ole_AppRoot
if isvalid(ole_IM) then destroy ole_IM

ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
destroy ole_RTXAPI

end subroutine
blocks.header: public subroutine uf_sendim (string as_receiver, string as_msg)

public function string uf_getdept ();long ll_rtn
string ls_dept,ls_Account
oleobject ole_RTXAPI
oleobject ole_KernalRoot
oleobject ole_App
oleobject ole_Helper

ole_RTXAPI=create oleobject
ll_rtn=ole_RTXAPI.ConnectToNewObject("RTXClient.RTXAPI")//("RTXCAPI.RTXCRoot")//("RTXClient.RTXAPI")
if ll_rtn<>0 then
	of_connecterrormsg(ll_rtn,"RTXClient.RTXAPI")
	destroy ole_RTXAPI
	return ""
end if
TRY
	
 	ole_App=create oleobject
	ole_App = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("AppRoot")
	
	ole_Helper=create oleobject
	ole_Helper = ole_App.GetAppObject("RTXHelper")
	
	ole_KernalRoot=create oleobject
	ole_KernalRoot = ole_RTXAPI.GetObject("KernalRoot")
	ls_Account=ole_KernalRoot.Account
	
	ls_dept = ole_Helper.GetBuddyDept(ls_Account)
	 
	
CATCH (throwable rtxloge)
FINALLY 
END TRY

if isvalid(ole_App) then destroy ole_App
if isvalid(ole_Helper) then destroy ole_Helper
if isvalid(ole_KernalRoot) then destroy ole_KernalRoot
ole_RTXAPI.disconnectobject()
destroy ole_RTXAPI

return ls_dept

end function
